lines.text: Heat me these irons hot; and look thou stand
lines.plainText: Heat me these irons hot and look thou stand

lines.text: Within the arras. When I strike my foot
lines.plainText: Within the arras When I strike my foot

lines.text: Upon the bosom of the ground, rush forth
lines.plainText: Upon the bosom of the ground rush forth

lines.text: And bind the boy which you shall find with me
lines.plainText: And bind the boy which you shall find with me

lines.text: Fast to the chair. Be heedful. Hence, and watch.
lines.plainText: Fast to the chair Be heedful Hence and watch

lines.text: I hope your warrant will bear out the deed.
lines.plainText: I hope your warrant will bear out the deed

lines.text: Uncleanly scruples! Fear not you; look to't.
lines.plainText: Uncleanly scruples Fear not you look to't

lines.text: Good morrow, Hubert.
lines.plainText: Good morrow Hubert

lines.text: Good morrow, little prince.
lines.plainText: Good morrow little prince

lines.text: As little prince, having so great a title
lines.plainText: As little prince having so great a title

lines.text: To be more prince, as may be. You are sad.
lines.plainText: To be more prince as may be You are sad

lines.text: Indeed, I have been merrier.
lines.plainText: Indeed I have been merrier

lines.text: Mercy on me!
lines.plainText: Mercy on me

lines.text: Methinks nobody should be sad but I.
lines.plainText: Methinks nobody should be sad but I

lines.text: Yet, I remember, when I was in France,
lines.plainText: Yet I remember when I was in France

lines.text: Young gentlemen would be as sad as night,
lines.plainText: Young gentlemen would be as sad as night

lines.text: Only for wantonness. By my christendom,
lines.plainText: Only for wantonness By my christendom

lines.text: So I were out of prison, and kept sheep,
lines.plainText: So I were out of prison and kept sheep

lines.text: I should be as merry as the day is long;
lines.plainText: I should be as merry as the day is long

lines.text: And so I would be here, but that I doubt
lines.plainText: And so I would be here but that I doubt

lines.text: My uncle practises more harm to me.
lines.plainText: My uncle practises more harm to me

lines.text: He is afraid of me, and I of him.
lines.plainText: He is afraid of me and I of him

lines.text: Is it my fault that I was Geoffrey's son?
lines.plainText: Is it my fault that I was Geoffrey's son

lines.text: No, indeed, is't not; and I would to heaven
lines.plainText: No indeed is't not and I would to heaven

lines.text: I were your son, so you would love me, Hubert.
lines.plainText: I were your son so you would love me Hubert

lines.text: [Aside.] If I talk to him, with his innocent prate
lines.plainText: Aside If I talk to him with his innocent prate

lines.text: He will awake my mercy, which lies dead.
lines.plainText: He will awake my mercy which lies dead

lines.text: Therefore I will be sudden and dispatch.
lines.plainText: Therefore I will be sudden and dispatch

lines.text: Are you sick, Hubert? You look pale today.
lines.plainText: Are you sick Hubert You look pale today

lines.text: In sooth, I would you were a little sick,
lines.plainText: In sooth I would you were a little sick

lines.text: That I might sit all night and watch with you.
lines.plainText: That I might sit all night and watch with you

lines.text: I warrant I love you more than you do me.
lines.plainText: I warrant I love you more than you do me

lines.text: [Aside.] His words do take possession of my bosom.
lines.plainText: Aside His words do take possession of my bosom

lines.text: Read here, young Arthur.
lines.plainText: Read here young Arthur

lines.text: Too fairly, Hubert, for so foul effect.
lines.plainText: Too fairly Hubert for so foul effect

lines.text: Must you with hot irons burn out both mine eyes?
lines.plainText: Must you with hot irons burn out both mine eyes

lines.text: Young boy, I must.
lines.plainText: Young boy I must

lines.text: And will you?
lines.plainText: And will you

lines.text: And I will.
lines.plainText: And I will

lines.text: Have you the heart? When your head did but ache,
lines.plainText: Have you the heart When your head did but ache

lines.text: I knit my handkercher about your brows,
lines.plainText: I knit my handkercher about your brows

lines.text: The best I had, a princess wrought it me,
lines.plainText: The best I had a princess wrought it me

lines.text: And I did never ask it you again;
lines.plainText: And I did never ask it you again

lines.text: And with my hand at midnight held your head,
lines.plainText: And with my hand at midnight held your head

lines.text: And, like the watchful minutes to the hour,
lines.plainText: And like the watchful minutes to the hour

lines.text: Still and anon cheer'd up the heavy time,
lines.plainText: Still and anon cheer'd up the heavy time

lines.text: Saying 'What lack you?" and "Where lies your grief?"
lines.plainText: Saying 'What lack you and Where lies your grief

lines.text: Or "What good love may I perform for you?"
lines.plainText: Or What good love may I perform for you

lines.text: Many a poor man's son would have lien still
lines.plainText: Many a poor man's son would have lien still

lines.text: And ne'er have spoke a loving word to you;
lines.plainText: And ne'er have spoke a loving word to you

lines.text: But you at your sick service had a prince.
lines.plainText: But you at your sick service had a prince

lines.text: Nay, you may think my love was crafty love,
lines.plainText: Nay you may think my love was crafty love

lines.text: And call it cunning. Do, an if you will.
lines.plainText: And call it cunning Do an if you will

lines.text: If heaven be pleas'd that you must use me ill,
lines.plainText: If heaven be pleas'd that you must use me ill

lines.text: Why then you must. Will you put out mine eyes?
lines.plainText: Why then you must Will you put out mine eyes

lines.text: These eyes that never did nor never shall
lines.plainText: These eyes that never did nor never shall

lines.text: So much as frown on you?
lines.plainText: So much as frown on you

lines.text: I have sworn to do it.
lines.plainText: I have sworn to do it

lines.text: And with hot irons must I burn them out.
lines.plainText: And with hot irons must I burn them out

lines.text: Ah, none but in this iron age would do it!
lines.plainText: Ah none but in this iron age would do it

lines.text: The iron of itself, though heat red-hot,
lines.plainText: The iron of itself though heat redhot

lines.text: Approaching near these eyes would drink my tears
lines.plainText: Approaching near these eyes would drink my tears

lines.text: And quench his fiery indignation
lines.plainText: And quench his fiery indignation

lines.text: Even in the matter of mine innocence;
lines.plainText: Even in the matter of mine innocence

lines.text: Nay, after that, consume away in rust,
lines.plainText: Nay after that consume away in rust

lines.text: But for containing fire to harm mine eye.
lines.plainText: But for containing fire to harm mine eye

lines.text: Are you more stubborn-hard than hammer'd iron?
lines.plainText: Are you more stubbornhard than hammer'd iron

lines.text: An if an angel should have come to me
lines.plainText: An if an angel should have come to me

lines.text: And told me Hubert should put out mine eyes,
lines.plainText: And told me Hubert should put out mine eyes

lines.text: I would not have believ'd him. No tongue but Hubert's.
lines.plainText: I would not have believ'd him No tongue but Hubert's

lines.text: [Stamps.] Come forth.
lines.plainText: Stamps Come forth

lines.text: O, save me, Hubert, save me! My eyes are out
lines.plainText: O save me Hubert save me My eyes are out

lines.text: Even with the fierce looks of these bloody men.
lines.plainText: Even with the fierce looks of these bloody men

lines.text: Give me the iron, I say, and bind him here.
lines.plainText: Give me the iron I say and bind him here

lines.text: Alas, what need you be so boist'rous-rough?
lines.plainText: Alas what need you be so boist'rousrough

lines.text: I will not struggle, I will stand stone-still.
lines.plainText: I will not struggle I will stand stonestill

lines.text: For heaven sake, Hubert, let me not be bound!
lines.plainText: For heaven sake Hubert let me not be bound

lines.text: Nay, hear me, Hubert! Drive these men away,
lines.plainText: Nay hear me Hubert Drive these men away

lines.text: And I will sit as quiet as a lamb;
lines.plainText: And I will sit as quiet as a lamb

lines.text: I will not stir, nor wince, nor speak a word,
lines.plainText: I will not stir nor wince nor speak a word

lines.text: Nor look upon the iron angerly.
lines.plainText: Nor look upon the iron angerly

lines.text: Thrust but these men away, and I'll forgive you,
lines.plainText: Thrust but these men away and I'll forgive you

lines.text: Whatever torment you do put me to.
lines.plainText: Whatever torment you do put me to

lines.text: Go, stand within; let me alone with him.
lines.plainText: Go stand within let me alone with him

lines.text: I am best pleas'd to be from such a deed.
lines.plainText: I am best pleas'd to be from such a deed

lines.text: Alas, I then have chid away my friend!
lines.plainText: Alas I then have chid away my friend

lines.text: He hath a stern look but a gentle heart.
lines.plainText: He hath a stern look but a gentle heart

lines.text: Let him come back, that his compassion may
lines.plainText: Let him come back that his compassion may

lines.text: Give life to yours.
lines.plainText: Give life to yours

lines.text: Come, boy, prepare yourself.
lines.plainText: Come boy prepare yourself

lines.text: Is there no remedy?
lines.plainText: Is there no remedy

lines.text: None, but to lose your eyes.
lines.plainText: None but to lose your eyes

lines.text: O heaven, that there were but a mote in yours,
lines.plainText: O heaven that there were but a mote in yours

lines.text: A grain, a dust, a gnat, a wandering hair,
lines.plainText: A grain a dust a gnat a wandering hair

lines.text: Any annoyance in that precious sense!
lines.plainText: Any annoyance in that precious sense

lines.text: Then, feeling what small things are boisterous there,
lines.plainText: Then feeling what small things are boisterous there

lines.text: Your vile intent must needs seem horrible.
lines.plainText: Your vile intent must needs seem horrible

lines.text: Is this your promise? Go to, hold your tongue.
lines.plainText: Is this your promise Go to hold your tongue

lines.text: Hubert, the utterance of a brace of tongues
lines.plainText: Hubert the utterance of a brace of tongues

lines.text: Must needs want pleading for a pair of eyes.
lines.plainText: Must needs want pleading for a pair of eyes

lines.text: Let me not hold my tongue. Let me not, Hubert,
lines.plainText: Let me not hold my tongue Let me not Hubert

lines.text: Or, Hubert, if you will, cut out my tongue,
lines.plainText: Or Hubert if you will cut out my tongue

lines.text: So I may keep mine eyes. O, spare mine eyes,
lines.plainText: So I may keep mine eyes O spare mine eyes

lines.text: Though to no use but still to look on you!
lines.plainText: Though to no use but still to look on you

lines.text: Lo, by my troth, the instrument is cold
lines.plainText: Lo by my troth the instrument is cold

lines.text: And would not harm me.
lines.plainText: And would not harm me

lines.text: I can heat it, boy.
lines.plainText: I can heat it boy

lines.text: No, in good sooth; the fire is dead with grief,
lines.plainText: No in good sooth the fire is dead with grief

lines.text: Being create for comfort, to be us'd
lines.plainText: Being create for comfort to be us'd

lines.text: In undeserv'd extremes. See else yourself.
lines.plainText: In undeserv'd extremes See else yourself

lines.text: There is no malice in this burning coal;
lines.plainText: There is no malice in this burning coal

lines.text: The breath of heaven hath blown his spirit out
lines.plainText: The breath of heaven hath blown his spirit out

lines.text: And strew'd repentant ashes on his head.
lines.plainText: And strew'd repentant ashes on his head

lines.text: But with my breath I can revive it, boy.
lines.plainText: But with my breath I can revive it boy

lines.text: An if you do, you will but make it blush
lines.plainText: An if you do you will but make it blush

lines.text: And glow with shame of your proceedings, Hubert.
lines.plainText: And glow with shame of your proceedings Hubert

lines.text: Nay, it perchance will sparkle in your eyes;
lines.plainText: Nay it perchance will sparkle in your eyes

lines.text: And, like a dog that is compell'd to fight,
lines.plainText: And like a dog that is compell'd to fight

lines.text: Snatch at his master that doth tarre him on.
lines.plainText: Snatch at his master that doth tarre him on

lines.text: All things that you should use to do me wrong
lines.plainText: All things that you should use to do me wrong

lines.text: Deny their office. Only you do lack
lines.plainText: Deny their office Only you do lack

lines.text: That mercy which fierce fire and iron extends,
lines.plainText: That mercy which fierce fire and iron extends

lines.text: Creatures of note for mercy-lacking uses.
lines.plainText: Creatures of note for mercylacking uses

lines.text: Well, see to live; I will not touch thine eye
lines.plainText: Well see to live I will not touch thine eye

lines.text: For all the treasure that thine uncle owes.
lines.plainText: For all the treasure that thine uncle owes

lines.text: Yet I am sworn, and I did purpose, boy,
lines.plainText: Yet I am sworn and I did purpose boy

lines.text: With this same very iron to burn them out.
lines.plainText: With this same very iron to burn them out

lines.text: O, now you look like Hubert! All this while
lines.plainText: O now you look like Hubert All this while

lines.text: You were disguised.
lines.plainText: You were disguised

lines.text: Peace; no more. Adieu.
lines.plainText: Peace no more Adieu

lines.text: Your uncle must not know but you are dead.
lines.plainText: Your uncle must not know but you are dead

lines.text: I'll fill these dogged spies with false reports.
lines.plainText: I'll fill these dogged spies with false reports

lines.text: And, pretty child, sleep doubtless and secure
lines.plainText: And pretty child sleep doubtless and secure

lines.text: That Hubert, for the wealth of all the world,
lines.plainText: That Hubert for the wealth of all the world

lines.text: Will not offend thee.
lines.plainText: Will not offend thee

lines.text: O heaven! I thank you, Hubert.
lines.plainText: O heaven I thank you Hubert

lines.text: Silence; no more. Go closely in with me.
lines.plainText: Silence no more Go closely in with me

lines.text: Much danger do I undergo for thee.
lines.plainText: Much danger do I undergo for thee
